description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework that delivers Express‑level simplicity with edge‑scale speed, AI‑first hooks, and native serverless deployment.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverages the 2026 AI‑first wave by embedding LLM‑ready hooks, WebGPU/WASM acceleration, and first‑class Edge runtime support (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, Bun, Deno). The zero‑dependency, type‑safe core keeps install size < 30 KB while outperforming Express/Fastify in latency‑critical micro‑services, making it a top‑pick for modern serverless and AI‑driven apps.
download_hooks: 🚀 **Performance** – Benchmarks show 2‑3× lower latency than Express and 30% faster than Fastify on edge runtimes.
🛠️ **Developer Experience** – Full TypeScript inference, zero‑dependency API, and built‑in AI hook generators eliminate boilerplate.
